audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Lucian Levels 1 through 4-5 and handed the 2+ items row to Zaahen, while the whys on the same page say the exact opposite at five of the seven rows — 'Level 1 is an even farm start', 'Level 2 favours him', 'Level 3 stays his', 'Levels 4-5 are a skill-check', 'Two items in it is a coin-flip'.
audit.why: Zaahen's Aureate Rush (E) is a dash on a 10s-to-8s cooldown that reaches Lucian the moment Relentless Pursuit is spent, and The Darkin Glaive (Q) out-ranges the poke with a knock-up on its recast. Lucian never owns the early levels here; the late game is genuinely even because his DPS wins open ground.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Zaahen / Skill in both layers, matching the packet and the prose, with ratings to suit.
sources: brief enemyKit Q cd 10/9/8/7/6 and E cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].why lines are the generic Lucian-dominant template — 'Passive double-shots win level 1 outright', 'First item spike is your kill window' — none of which is true in this matchup and all of which now contradict the chart.
audit.why: The real spikes are his: Level 2 on The Darkin Glaive's range and recast knock-up, Levels 3 and first item on Aureate Rush all-ins timed to Lucian's dash, and 6 on Grim Deliverance's heal (110s at rank 1). Lucian's only reliable stage is the 4-5 poke window between engages.
audit.corrected: Every phase why rewritten to the real owner and the real cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names a single one of Zaahen's abilities — the focus token literally reads 'Zaahen Ultimate' and the cooldown line calls it 'His big cooldown'.
audit.why: 'Ultimate' is not an ability name. The ultimate is Grim Deliverance, a 110/95/80 stab that heals him for a portion of the damage dealt; The Darkin Glaive (Q) heals, double-slashes and resets his attack, with a recast that knocks up; Aureate Rush (E) is the dash that carries percent-health damage. Without the names the reader cannot track anything.
audit.corrected: Focus, loading, win condition, cooldown line and report entries now name Grim Deliverance; the content prose names The Darkin Glaive and Aureate Rush.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/E/R text and flags
missingInteractions headlines naming The Darkin Glaive, Aureate Rush, Grim Deliverance

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal anywhere on the page, and nothing warns that Aureate Rush's damage scales on maximum health.
audit.why: He heals off both The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance, so Grievous Wounds decides every extended trade; and because his dash carries percent-health damage, stacking armour alone reads the all-in wrong.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d and mid now carry the anti-heal instruction.
sources: brief enemyKit heal flags on Q and R, percentHealth flag on E

notes: Zaahen's ability names came from the missingInteractions headlines (The Darkin Glaive Q, Aureate Rush E, Grim Deliverance R) — packet.enemyAbilities is null for this champion and the kit file carries text without names. I found no name for his W anywhere in the brief, so the page still refers to that ability only by what it does, and I did not invent one. Question for the user: what is Zaahen's W called? Once it has a name, the pull should be written into the trading rules, because an 850-range pull into his knock-up recast is the real all-in starter in this matchup and the page currently ignores it entirely.
